authority.selection_basis: Prespecified scientific meaning and outcome-blind coverage only; no empirical predictive result was inspected.

scientific_scope.question: Whether temporal alignment and historical country context improve prediction between period-specific P and HLO on declared outputs.
claim_limits: Does not identify true national cognitive ability.
Does not establish a causal effect or causal lag.
Does not validate either indicator for unobserved countries.
Does not constitute real-time historical forecasting from retrospectively revised WDI data.

primary.endpoint_rule: History ends before the assessment-window start.

same_window_context.exception: May be evaluated predictively only after separate explicit approval.

context_timing.timing_comparison_sample_rule: For any timing comparison, refit the primary specification on the exact common country-period intersection; do not compare unmatched performance samples.

historical_feature_construction.annual_observation_unit: one unique calendar year per country-feature
historical_feature_construction.duplicate_rule: duplicate country-feature-year rows require explicit source reconciliation and are never double-counted
historical_feature_construction.usable_mean: arithmetic mean of available requested annual values after threshold passes

assessment_specific_fixed_contribution.positive_weight_requirement: every positive-weight target contribution must have a usable history for the feature

weighted_ols.design: sqrt(weight) multiplied augmented [1, Z] and standardized target

transformations.feature_standardization: fit within each relevant training fold only
transformations.target_standardization: fit within each relevant training fold only
transformations.prediction_reporting: inverse-transform predictions and score errors to original target units

score_metrics.unitless_MSE_improvement_vs_M0: 1 - MSE_model / MSE_M0; null when MSE_M0 is zero

required_saved_artifacts_after_approval: exact input hashes and row identities
outer and inner country split assignments
candidate tuning scores and selected penalties
held-out predictions for every evaluated cell and model

implementation_readiness.reason: Author approval and a matching passed measurement-gate record are still absent.

matched_intersection_rules.S10_S12_SA5: freeze exact primary-and-alternative eligible intersection before fitting; refit both constructions with identical splits and weights

remaining_author_action: explicitly approve this exact new protocol hash in a separate record
